en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abd Allah. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to us: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should marry, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding the private parts. Whoever cannot afford it should fast, for fasting is a protection for him.

en: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid. Abd Allah, Alqamah, and al-Aswad visited Abd Allah, and he said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) as young men without property. He said: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should marry, for it lowers the gaze and guards the private parts. Whoever cannot should fast, for fasting is a protection. He said: I married soon afterward.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Nafi narrated to us. Bahz narrated to us. Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas. He said: Some companions came to the houses of the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him) asking about his worship. One said: I will not marry women. Another said: I will not eat meat. Another said: I will not sleep on a bed. The Prophet praised Allah and said: What is the matter with people who say such things? I pray and sleep, fast and break the fast, and marry women. Whoever turns away from my Sunnah is not of me.

He said: We went on raids with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and had no wives with us. We asked whether we should castrate ourselves, but he forbade us and permitted us to marry women temporarily for a period in exchange for a garment. Then he recited: “O believers, do not forbid the good things Allah made lawful for you and do not transgress; Allah does not love transgressors.” (Quran 5:87; verse 87)

en: Qutaybah narrated to us. Layth narrated to us, from Rabi ibn Sabrah al-Juhani, from his father. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) permitted temporary marriage. Sabrah and another man went to a woman of Banu Amir who was like a tall young virgin. They offered themselves to her, and she asked what they would give her. I said my cloak, and my companion said his cloak. My companion's cloak was better, but I was younger, so she chose me and my cloak. We stayed three days. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) ordered those who had such women to release them.
